THE GLOBAL REACH OF A PEDAL PRESS
Through Sagitario, Rivera
launched a massive solidarity
campaign for Nicola Sacco
and Bartolomeo Vanzetti,
Vanzetti, two anarchists
facing the electric
chair in Massachusetts.
Rivera's agitation
triggered boycotts of US
goods and strikes by
Mexican oil workers.
"Comrade Rivera.. only the
workers of the world can
save us from the electric
chair... Place a red flower
on the grave of our
unforgettable Ricardo."
- Letter from Vanzetti to Rivera, 1925
